header.title: Business Knowledge
header.subtitle: Manage the shared business knowledge and rules available to every AI Agent.

overview.title: Business overview
overview.description: See what is ready for your AI Agents and continue setup where you left off.
overview.setupGuideHint: For the step-by-step checklist, use Setup Guide in the sidebar. Progress updates from saved business data.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: Add contact, location, and opening details.

catalog.title: Products or services
catalog.description: Set up the products or service forms your business offers.

operations.title: Business rules
operations.description: Set shared policies and operating rules.

knowledge.title: Business Knowledge
knowledge.description: Add FAQs, documents, and answers shared with every Agent.

agents.title: AI Agents
agents.description: Assign each Agent a role and responsibilities.

channels.title: Connected channels
channels.description: Connect the platforms where your Agents will work.

faqs.description: Manage your business FAQs so the AI answers customers accurately.
faqs.empty: No FAQs added yet. Click the 'Add FAQ' button to create one.
faqs.answerPlaceholder: We're open Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm.
faqs.modalHelper: Write a question a customer might ask, and the exact answer your AI should give.
faqs.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? Your AI will no longer use this Q&A pair.
faqs.validationError: Please fill in both question and answer
faqs.bulkDeleteConfirm: Are you sure? This will permanently delete {{count}} FAQs.

sampleReplies.description: Manage sample replies to help the AI generate consistent responses.
sampleReplies.empty: No sample replies added yet. Click the 'Add Reply' button to create one.
sampleReplies.emptySearch: No sample replies match your search.
sampleReplies.replyPlaceholder: Yes! We deliver to Dhaka within 1-2 days. 🚚
sampleReplies.modalHelper: Show the AI a real customer situation and how you'd ideally respond. It learns your voice from these examples.
sampleReplies.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? Your AI will no longer use this tone example.
sampleReplies.bulkDeleteConfirm: Are you sure? This will permanently delete {{count}} sample replies.

contentTraining.agentOnlyDescription: These sources are private to {{name}}. Workspace knowledge is shared separately with all agents.
contentTraining.sharedDescription: Add documents, text, or websites shared with every agent in this workspace.

autoTrain.title: Auto-train your agent
autoTrain.description: Pick the profiles to learn from. We'll read your recent posts, comments and conversations to build your business profile and draft FAQs, sample replies and content training — across all selected platforms, with duplicates removed. You review and pick what to keep; nothing goes live until you approve it.
autoTrain.chatsToTrain: How many recent chats to train on?
autoTrain.noProfiles: No connected platforms yet. Connect Facebook, WhatsApp or Instagram from Integrations to auto-train your agent.
autoTrain.whatsappCaveat: WhatsApp & Instagram have no chat-history API — we can only train on messages received since you connected them.
autoTrain.reviewDescription: Review each type, edit if needed, then add it. Each tab saves on its own — Finish when you're done.
autoTrain.foundCount: Found {{count}} suggestions. Uncheck anything you don't want.
autoTrain.emptyDrafts: We couldn't find enough in these conversations to draft training. Try selecting more chats or another platform.
autoTrain.noConversations: No conversations found on the selected platforms yet.
autoTrain.sourceAgentHint: Choose an agent to review conversations from. Approved answers will be shared with every agent in this business.
autoTrain.noSourceAgent: Create an AI Agent before learning from conversations.
autoTrain.applyFailed: Failed to add items. Please try again.

companyAiRules.title: Business Rules
companyAiRules.description: These business-wide instructions apply to every AI Agent. Manage FAQs and documents in their own tabs.
companyAiRules.readOnly: You can view these rules, but only a workspace owner or admin can edit them.
companyAiRules.brandVoiceHint: How should the agent sound? For example, polite and concise.
companyAiRules.languagePolicyHint: Describe preferred languages and when to mirror the customer's language.
companyAiRules.customerAddressHint: For example, use 'you' and a respectful form of address.
companyAiRules.listHint: Add one rule per line (up to 20). These apply to every agent.
companyAiRules.boundariesHint: What must agents avoid saying, promising, or recommending?
companyAiRules.additionalInstructionsHint: Optional shared instructions that do not fit the fields above.
companyAiRules.customLevelsHint: Create your own rule category and add the instruction agents should follow.
companyAiRules.customLevelNameHint: Give this rule category a short name.
companyAiRules.customInstructionHint: Write what every agent should follow for this category.
companyAiRules.customLevelsEmpty: No custom levels yet. Add one when the standard fields do not cover a company rule.
companyAiRules.customLevelsLimit: You can add up to 20 custom levels.
companyAiRules.customLevelValidationError: Add a name to every custom level before saving.

companyKnowledge.title: Business Knowledge
companyKnowledge.description: Add business policies, delivery rules, and common answers once. Every AI Agent in this business can use them.
companyKnowledge.namePlaceholder: Source name, e.g. Delivery and return policy
companyKnowledge.contentPlaceholder: Add company policies, delivery details, and other shared information...
companyKnowledge.addSuccess: Business Knowledge added for every AI Agent.
companyKnowledge.deleteConfirm: This source will be removed for every AI Agent in this business.
companyKnowledge.noAgentsHint: Create an AI Agent to set its role and add optional private references. Business Knowledge remains shared above.

scope.title: Choose a knowledge area
scope.workspaceDescription: Shared policies, reference information, and business data used by every AI Agent.
scope.agentDescription: Set an Agent's role and responsibilities, with optional private references.
scope.privateToSelected: Set this Agent's role in its setup. Optional private references are managed below.
scope.sharedCount: {{count}} shared sources are available to this Agent.
scope.noSharedSources: No Business Knowledge sources yet. Add company policies once to share them with every Agent.

businessData.title: Business Data
businessData.description: Manage core business facts once. Your AI Agents read current products, orders, offers, delivery connections, and records from their existing modules.
businessData.deliveryNote: Save customer-facing delivery areas, charges, and timing in the profile or Business Rules. Courier credentials stay in Courier Settings.

assistant.title: Describe your business
assistant.description: Type or dictate a short description. AI will suggest profile fields for you to review; nothing is saved until you approve and save it.
assistant.placeholder: For example: We are a clothing store in Dhaka. We open Saturday to Thursday, accept cash and bKash, and deliver inside Dhaka in 1–2 days.
assistant.voiceError: Voice input could not be captured. You can type your description instead.
assistant.reviewDescription: Check every value. Applying fills empty fields; it does not overwrite existing saved details or save the form.
assistant.applied: Suggestions added to empty profile fields. Review and save them when ready.

deliveryPolicy.title: Delivery areas and charges
deliveryPolicy.description: Add exact area names customers use. AI will quote these saved charges, and order creation checks the confirmed fee against the matching area.
deliveryPolicy.empty: No delivery areas configured. Without them, the AI should confirm delivery charges with your team.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: Add basic facts once so every Agent can answer consistently.

products.title: Products
products.description: Manage the product catalog and availability.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Review customer orders and fulfillment status.

delivery.title: Delivery & Fulfillment
delivery.description: Manage courier connections and delivery settings.

records.title: Business Records
records.description: Manage appointments, inquiries, and other business forms.

agentInstructions.title: Define {{name}}’s role
agentInstructions.description: Business facts and live records come from Business Knowledge. Set this Agent’s job, response behavior, and permitted forms here.

purpose.label: Purpose

responsibilities.hint: Which customer requests should it handle?

tone.label: Response style
tone.hint: Describe how it should speak to customers.

handoff.label: Human handoff
handoff.hint: When should it stop and ask a person to help?

boundaries.label: Boundaries
boundaries.hint: What should it avoid promising, changing, or doing?

agentInstructions.formsHint: Only selected forms can receive records from this Agent. Leave all unchecked to disable custom form submissions.
agentInstructions.noForms: No business forms are configured for this workspace yet.
